dialogue.content: こんばんは。今日はよろしくお願いします。１９時になったら始めようと思いますが、それで大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for coming today. I was thinking we could start at 7 p.m., would that be all right with you?

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. That's fine.

dialogue.content: 何か理想のクライエント像などはありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there an ideal type of client you'd like me to portray?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。実は、余り答えて下さらないCLが苦手です。ただ、上手く出来る自信が無いので、ご迷惑をおかけするかもしれません。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Actually, I find it difficult to work with clients who don't respond much. However, I'm not confident that I can do it well, so I might cause you some inconvenience.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: じゃあ寡黙な感じなクライエント演じます。
dialogue.English: Then I'll act as a reserved client.

dialogue.content: 頑張ります。こんばんは。相談員です。
dialogue.English: I’ll do my best. Good evening. I’m the counselor.

dialogue.content: 今日はどんなご相談でお越し頂きましたか？
dialogue.English: What brought you in today?

dialogue.content: こんばんは
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: 学校にいきたくないんです。
dialogue.English: I don’t want to go to school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: それはお辛いですね。
dialogue.English: That must be difficult for you.

dialogue.content: いつから、そんなお気持ちになりましたか？
dialogue.English: Since when have you been feeling that way?

dialogue.content: 中学入学した時から
dialogue.English: Since I started middle school.

dialogue.content: そなんですね・・・今、何年生なのでしょう？
dialogue.English: I see... What grade are you in now?

dialogue.content: 1年
dialogue.English: First year.

dialogue.content: 中学１年生なのですね？入学した時から学校に行きたくないと思われているんですね。約半年間、そんな風に思って学校に行っているのには何かきっかけはありましたか？
dialogue.English: So you’re in your first year of middle school, and you’ve felt you didn’t want to go since you enrolled. For about half a year you’ve been feeling that way while attending—was there any particular trigger?

dialogue.content: 先生が怖い
dialogue.English: The teacher is scary.

dialogue.content: 音楽の先生が嫌だ
dialogue.English: I don't like the music teacher.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。音楽の先生なんですね。どんな風にこわいのか、少し聞いても大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: I see. It's the music teacher. Would it be okay to ask you a little about how they are scary?

dialogue.content: 教科書投げてくるんです。
dialogue.English: They throw textbooks at me.

dialogue.content: お前が気に食わねぇって
dialogue.English: Saying, "I can’t stand you."

dialogue.content: えっ？そんな事を・・・それは酷い。
dialogue.English: What? For them to do something like that... That’s terrible.

dialogue.content: 入学して直ぐですか？
dialogue.English: Did that happen right after you started school?

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: びっくりしたでしょ？
dialogue.English: You must have been really shocked.

dialogue.content: 痛かった
dialogue.English: It hurt.

dialogue.content: 僕がちゃんと歌わないからって
dialogue.English: They said it was because I wasn't singing properly.

dialogue.content: 投げてきた
dialogue.English: They threw it at me.

dialogue.content: どんな理由があっても、生徒に教科書を投げるなんて良くないです。そんな戸惑う事があったのに、今まで学校に毎日ちゃんと登校してきたんですね。頑張ってますね。
dialogue.English: No matter the reason, throwing a textbook at a student is unacceptable. Even though you went through something so upsetting, you still kept going to school every day until now. You’ve been doing your best.

dialogue.content: 学校には行かなきゃ行けないから。
dialogue.English: Because I have to go to school.

dialogue.content: でも夏休み開けてからは行ってないです。
dialogue.English: But I haven't gone since summer break ended.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。学校には行かなきゃいけないと思って頑張って来たのに、今は行けて無いんですね。それは気持ちがモヤモヤしますね・・
dialogue.English: I see. You’d been pushing yourself because you felt you had to go, but now you haven’t been able to. That must leave you feeling unsettled.

dialogue.content: 学校には、今、行きたくないと思っているという事でしたが、そんな気持ちをご両親にはご相談してみましたか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned that you don't want to go to school right now. Have you talked to your parents about these feelings?

dialogue.content: あんまり
dialogue.English: Not really.

dialogue.content: 先生が嫌だから行かないって言っただけ。
dialogue.English: I just said I wouldn’t go because I don’t like the teacher.

dialogue.content: その気持ちに対して、ご両親は何か言われていますか？
dialogue.English: And what did your parents say to that?

dialogue.content: 嫌ならいいんじゃない？って
dialogue.English: They said, "If you don't want to, then that's fine."

dialogue.content: 学校行かなくても死にはしないしって
dialogue.English: They said, "Not going to school won't kill you."

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。毎日家にいて過ごすのは、どんな感じですか？気持ち的に楽になりましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. How does it feel to be at home every day? Do you feel more at ease?

dialogue.content: ゲームしてるから楽しい
dialogue.English: It's fun because I'm playing games.

dialogue.content: ゲームをしてるんですね。じゃあ、あんまり今は、学校の事思ったりしてないのでしょうか？ご飯とか、ちゃんと決まったっ時間に食べれてますか？
dialogue.English: So you're playing games. Does that mean you're not thinking much about school right now? Are you eating your meals at regular times?

dialogue.content: あんまり。でも友達と会えないのは寂しいし、大人になって働けないのも困る。
dialogue.English: Not really. But it's lonely not seeing my friends, and I'm worried I won't be able to get a job when I grow up.

dialogue.content: ご飯は適当。起きたら食べてる
dialogue.English: I just eat whenever. I eat when I wake up.

dialogue.content: ゲームも楽しいけど、ご飯もちゃんとたべてね。お友達も心配してるんじゃないかな？
dialogue.English: Games are fun, but please make sure you eat properly too. I imagine your friends might be worried about you as well.

dialogue.content: 大人になってからの事を考えると、不安になったりもするんですよね。もし、その音楽の先生との事が解決したら、また、学校に行ってもいいかな、とか考えたりした事ありますか？
dialogue.English: Thinking about adulthood can make you feel anxious. If the issue with the music teacher were resolved, have you ever thought you might be able to go back to school?

dialogue.content: 2人くらいの友達とはゲーム内で話したりはする。
dialogue.English: I talk with a couple of friends in the game.

dialogue.content: んー
dialogue.English: Hmm...

dialogue.content: どうだろう・・・
dialogue.English: What do you think...?

dialogue.content: 音楽の先生が消えても、勉強追いつかなそうで行けなさそう
dialogue.English: Even if the music teacher were gone, I probably wouldn't be able to catch up with my studies, so I don't think I could go.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。勉強の事が心配なんですね。そうですね、そこは気になりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see—you’re worried about your studies. Yes, that’s understandable.

dialogue.content: 元々頭良くないし
dialogue.English: I'm not that smart to begin with.

dialogue.content: ちゃんと大人になった時の事、心配してるじゃ無ですか？ちゃんと、自分の将来を考えてる。大丈夫。担任の先生に電話でもいいから、その気持ちを相談してみたら？先生から、連絡はありますか？
dialogue.English: But you are worried about what will happen when you're an adult, aren't you? You're thinking about your future. It's okay. How about you try talking to your homeroom teacher about these feelings, even just over the phone? Has your teacher contacted you?

dialogue.content: 親には電話来てる
dialogue.English: They’ve been calling my parents.

dialogue.content: プリント渡しにたまに家にも来る
dialogue.English: They sometimes come to the house to drop off handouts.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。ありがたいですね。自分で、先生に会って話をしてみることは出来そうですか？
dialogue.English: I see. That's very thoughtful of them. Do you think you would be able to meet your teacher and talk to them yourself?

dialogue.content: 先生、気にかけてくれてますね。
dialogue.English: Your teacher seems to care about you.

dialogue.content: 担任の先生は優しい
dialogue.English: My homeroom teacher is kind.

dialogue.content: んー。
dialogue.English: Hmm.

dialogue.content: ちょっと難しい。
dialogue.English: It’s a bit difficult.

dialogue.content: 親に言ってもらうなら
dialogue.English: If my parents were to talk to them for me,

dialogue.content: できそう
dialogue.English: I think I could do it.

dialogue.content: そうか、それは良かった。じゃあ、親御さんに、今の自分の本当の気持ち、不安な事とか、何故学校に行けなくなってしまったのか、先生に話てもらったらどうでしょう？
dialogue.English: I see, that's good. Then how about you ask your parents to tell your teacher your true feelings, what you're worried about, and why you haven't been able to go to school?

dialogue.content: わかった。言ってみる。
dialogue.English: Okay. I’ll try asking them.

dialogue.content: 優しい先生なら、話を聞いてくれると思いますよ。
dialogue.English: If your teacher is kind, I think they will listen.

dialogue.content: でも大人ってこういう都合悪いこと隠そうとしない？
dialogue.English: But don’t adults try to hide inconvenient things like this?

dialogue.content: 話してどうなるかは正直分からないですが、でもね、優しい先生と一緒に、こらからどうしていけばいいかを一緒に考えれば、何か浮かんでくると思います。
dialogue.English: To be honest, I don't know what will happen if you talk to them, but if you think together with your kind teacher about what to do from now on, I think you'll come up with something.

dialogue.content: 自分の思いを伝えて見たらどうかと思います。どうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Perhaps you could try expressing your feelings. What do you think?

dialogue.content: わかった。やってみる。
dialogue.English: Okay. I’ll give it a try.

dialogue.content: そうですね。その勇気があれば、きっと何か方法がみつかると思いますよ。応援しています。
dialogue.English: Yes. With that courage, I’m sure you’ll find a way. I’m rooting for you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。明日親に言ってみます。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. I'll talk to my parents tomorrow.

dialogue.content: そろそろ相談の時間が終了しますが、大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: Our session time is almost over, is that okay?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: では、これで、終りますね。また、何かあったらいつでも来てください。
dialogue.English: All right, we’ll end here. Please feel free to come back anytime if anything comes up.

dialogue.content: (自分でやってて言うのもあれですが、このクライエント役にパンチしてやりたくなりました(笑))
dialogue.English: (It's strange for me to say this since I'm the one playing the role, but I wanted to punch this client character (lol))

dialogue.content: (対応の参考になり、勉強になりました。)
dialogue.English: (This was very helpful as a reference for how to handle this, and I learned a lot.)

dialogue.content: そんな事無いです。凄く勉強になりました。本当にありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Not at all. I learned a great deal. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 失礼します。
dialogue.English: I’ll take my leave now.

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)
